title: BLS Polymers IPO Details
intro:
BLS Polymers IPO is a book build issue of ₹255.00 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 1.70 crore shares of ₹255.00 crore.

BLS Polymers IPO opens for subscription on Oct 27, 2026 and closes on Oct 29, 2026. The allotment for the BLS Polymers IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 30, 2026. BLS Polymers IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 3, 2026.

BLS Polymers IPO is set issue price band at ₹142 to ₹150 per share. The lot size for an application is 100 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹15,000 (100 shares) (based on upper price).

Unistone Capital Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to BLS Polymers IPO RHP for detailed Information.

Updated on Oct 26, 2026 BLS Polymers Ltd. manufactures specialised polymer compounds used in wires, cables and underground pipelines. Its products include HDPE, MDPE, LLDPE, XLPE, PVC, HFFR, cable filling compounds and adhesive coating compounds, catering to industries such as power, telecommunications, railways, water, and oil and gas. The company operates a manufacturing facility in Goa, spread across approximately 24,220 sq. metres and equipped with 11 machines. It has an in-house laboratory, a quality control team and ISO 9001:2015 certification. The company also develops customised products to meet specific customer requirements. BLS Polymers serves more than 190 customers and exports its products to countries including Bangladesh, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, the USA and Zambia. Its proximity to Mormugao Port supports the import of raw materials and export of finished products. Competitive Strengths Government Approvals: Enlisted with prominent government agencies with a pre-approved product portfolio. Diversified Product Portfolio: Caters to multiple industries with specialised polymer compounds. Established Customer Relationships: More than 100 customers have been associated with the company for over three years. Wide Market Presence: Serves customers across India and international markets. faqs.question: How to apply in BLS Polymers IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in BLS Polymers IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in BLS Polymers IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in BLS Polymers IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' BLS Polymers IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for BLS Polymers IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in BLS Polymers IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is BLS Polymers IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for BLS Polymers IPO will be done on Friday, October 30, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Nov 2, 2026 . Check the BLS Polymers IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The BLS Polymers IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Tue, Nov 3, 2026 .
